name: Scaffold-GS
definition: A Gaussian-based approach that utilizes anchor points to establish a hierarchical and region-aware 3D scene representation, predicting neural Gaussian attributes on-the-fly based on viewing direction and distance.
summary: Scaffold-GS is a Gaussian-based scene representation using anchor points to constrain Gaussian distribution, achieving significantly reduced storage and real-time rendering speeds compared to vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting.
